data.reasoning: The deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash report provides a complete and sound analysis: the PKGBUILD fetches from the package's own declared upstream GitHub repository (aunetx/blur-my-shell) at a fixed tag (v73) with a checksum, uses standard build tooling (make), and performs no network operations or code execution beyond normal packaging. data.disagreement_analysis: The 'disagreement' was triggered by inconclusive results, but there is no actual analytical disagreement. Report 1 (qwen) failed on 4/5 files due to HTTP 400 API errors. Report 3 (openrouter, advisory-only) had a parser failure on PKGBUILD despite the model providing a valid safe analysis. Only Report 2 (deepseek) completed successfully with a safe verdict, and its reasoning is correct under the threat model.
